submitted_implementation: Fixed-site models adjusted for photoperiod; separate latitude models; fixed-site and random-site comparison; manuscript wording implied site differences after accounting for latitude and photoperiod
audited_implementation: Fixed site plus centered photoperiod is primary; the same-frame constrained latitude model replaces fixed site while retaining the participant random structure and omits random site; a random-site model is separately descriptive; IS and IV use participant-mean photoperiod
change_rationale: Latitude is constant within site; joint fixed site plus latitude is rank deficient and the constrained site-versus-latitude comparison requires identical frames and random structures
notes: Outcome-blinded method gate and both prepared model datasets are approved and verified; no main or manuscript-prepared-data H01 model result exists yet.
